Some of the statements mentioned in today's earnings call may be forward-looking in nature'
Such forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties which would cause
actual results to differ from those anticipated. Such statements are based on management

Thank you, Purvangi. Good evening, everyone. lt's a pleasure to welcome you to the earnings
conference call for the second quarter and first half of the Financial Year 2027. Let me brief
you on the financial performance of the quarter, followed by some of the key operational
high lights.
On a standalone basis, operating income for the company for the second quarter stood at Rs'
1,957 crores against Rs.1,100 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. The EBITDA
increased to Rs. 160 crores with a margin of 8.t2%. Profit after tax almost doubled to Rs' 95
crores. Jump in turnover is partly due to increase in volumes and the balance is all due to
increase in the selling prices, consequent to increase in the raw material prices. For the first
half of the Financial Year 2027, operating income increased to Rs. 3,649 crores with total
EBITDA of Rs. 508 crores. Profit after tax grew to Rs. 331 crores with a PAT margin of 9'08%'
On the operational front during the first half of the Financial Year 2027, our business
navigated a challenging operating environment marked by volatility in sterling prices,
disturbed supply chain, elevated ocean freight rates and subdued export volumes'
Additionally, duty-free imports of PS and ABS from ASEAN countries and China intensified
competitive pressure on the domestic selling prices during the first 2 months of the second
quarter.
Our total sales volume for Q2 FY27 stood at 95,242 Mf registering a 24%o year-on-year and
35% quarter-on-quarter increase. However, HI FY27 sales volume declined 3% year-on-year
to 1,66,085 MT primarily due to lower exports amid supply constraints, longer transit times
and higher freight costs.
We continue to diversify our sourcing network for imported raw materials to address supply
uncertainties from the Gulf region. On the growth front, our expansion plan remains on track,
including the new wide-width insulation board line with a capacity of 1,50,000 cubic metres
and the expansion of compounding capacity from 50,000 tons to 80,000 tons per annum.
Company continues to remain debt-free with an investable surplus of Rs.886 crores as of
September 2026. Our capital expenditure continues to be funded entirely through internal
cash accruals, reflecting our strong financial position and disciplined capital allocation' The
Board has also approved an interim dividend of I25%, translating to Rs. 2.5 per equity share,
reaffirming the Company's commitment to rewarding shareholders. With this, I conclude my
operating remarks, We now open the floor to the question-and-answer session' Thank you'
